title: Material selection for stiffness at low weight
summary: Materials have a stiffness (Young's modulus) and a density; a part's shape and loading decide which combination of the two (a performance index) sets its mass. The Ashby chart plots both on log axes so each index is a family of straight lines.

concepts.label: Material
concepts.description: A Wikidata item with mechanical properties: an alloy, a polymer, a wood, a composite, an element or a mineral.

children.label: Material class
children.description: metal, element, wood, polymer, composite, ceramic or mineral, sorted from the label and description by keyword.

children.label: Young's modulus
children.description: Stiffness in tension, E (GPa): recorded (P5480) or computed from K and G.

children.label: Bulk and shear modulus
children.description: K (P5668) and G (P5673); for an isotropic solid E = 9KG/(3K+G).

children.label: Anisotropy
children.description: Wood and fibre composites are stiff along the grain or fibres and several times softer across; single crystals differ by direction too. Not in the data.

children.label: Strength
children.description: Yield (P5529) and tensile strength (P5479): sparse on Wikidata; the next set of indices (σ/ρ, σ^(2/3)/ρ) needs them.

concepts.label: Performance index
concepts.description: The material combination that minimizes a part's mass for a required stiffness, from the part's loading and its free dimension (Ashby's method).

facts.text: Ashby's material-selection charts and indices: M. F. Ashby, Materials Selection in Mechanical Design (1992).

children.label: Specific stiffness E/ρ
children.description: Tie or strut in tension: mass ∝ ρ/E. In MJ/kg. Steel, aluminium and titanium all near 25.

children.label: Beam index E^½/ρ
children.description: Beam in bending with a free cross-section size: mass ∝ ρ/E^½.

children.label: Panel index E^⅓/ρ
children.description: Plate or panel in bending with a free thickness: mass ∝ ρ/E^⅓. Spruce, beryllium, carbon-fibre composite and magnesium lead.

children.label: Strength indices
children.description: σ/ρ and σ^(2/3)/ρ for parts that must not yield: the next chart.

concepts.label: Data provenance
concepts.description: Wikidata statements: recorded values with units (normalized to SI by the query service), and unreferenced K/G values that look computed.

children.label: DFT elastic constants
children.description: AFLOW's AEL-AGL elastic moduli for thousands of crystals (catalog: aflow), to compare with the computed-looking Wikidata K and G.
